question.text: Which of the following is NOT included in the 'Executive Summary' section of a Category III AIF's PPM?

answer.text: Target Corpus of the Fund and Classes of Units
Minimum Capital Commitment and Sponsor Commitment
Detailed year-wise illustration of fees and expenses
Investment Objective, Investment Strategy and Leverage Strategy

explanation.text: The Logic: Year-wise illustrations belong to the separate 'Illustrations of Fees, Expenses and Other Charges' section, not the Executive Summary. The Trap: Target corpus, sponsor commitment, and investment strategy ARE summarised in the Executive Summary per Table 5.2. Cross-Exam Context: Same structural separation exists across all AIF PPMs. Distributor's Pro-Tip: The Executive Summary is the section distributors rely on most — but always cross-verify fees against the dedicated Illustrations section.
